description:
The M10 Booker seemed like a procurement success. After decades without a light tank replacement, the Army developed exactly what it requested: a 105mm-cannon-armed vehicle to support infantry. Soldiers approved, production began. Then in 2025, leadership abruptly cancelled it, citing changed battlefield priorities after Ukraine demonstrated drone warfare's logistical impact.
